text: great for the uvs, when any atlas is made at all, do we store the positions so that we can reset or no? i dont think we do because i dont think there is any formal way to reset it to its original state, lets pass that in since it seems right now i have to manually reimport the model
resolution: Added a durable atlas-generation UV reset contract. Every newly created/remade atlas now captures its complete face-corner layout in atlases/uv-reset.json using signed workspace coordinates, while routine UV/paint saves preserve that baseline. Existing v4 packages lazily adopt their last exact saved layout, so they do not need reimport. The UV editor now exposes RMB → Texture Atlas → Reset UV Layout; restore is topology/count guarded, saved immediately, and recorded as one native undoable reset action. Signed off-image UV coordinates are also persisted under the same finite bound as the native infinite workspace.
